name: Youth on Boards (Summer Academy and board seat)
org: City of Saint Paul (Parks and Recreation, Right Track and Sprockets)
what_you_do: A paid 8 week Summer Academy gets you ready to join a city board. The term is two years. Boards include Parks and Recreation, Transportation and Neighborhood Safety.
pay_detail: Academy is a paid YJ2 internship at $15 an hour, 20 hours a week, Monday to Thursday. Board members also get up to $125 in stipends for meetings and learning tasks.
duration: 8 weeks (June 20 to Aug 10 on the page, no year), then 6 to 10 hours a month for two years
deadline_text: No deadline is listed. The page does not give a year for its dates, so treat them as a yearly pattern.
how_to_apply: Apply for the YJ2 internship through Right Track. Contact Furo Ejero, Furo.Ejero@ci.stpaul.mn.us or 651-266-8989.
notes: School year meetings may mean being excused from class. Right Track has its own program and application; see its own card.
